name: Jinx Pistol
summary: A Sinner's jinx weapon: Pistol statistics, 1d10 Force (30/90 ft), Vex; no Loading, and it makes its own shots.
text: A pistol, or a set of cards or dice that fights as one, made in a Sinner's hour-long ritual. For its maker it needs no loading and conjures its own hexed shots.
